title: SPARK: Secure Passwordless Authentication with Reveal-committed Knowledge
description: SPARK is a formally verified, zero-trusted-party protocol suite for passwordless local OS login, pairing a desktop with a smartphone the user already owns. This artifact contains the SPARK-Pairing and SPARK-Authentication ProVerif models, the EasyCrypt mechanisation of the hash commitment scheme, a Linux PAM module implementation, and an Android companion app.
